100拍首次实测：执行通过，回摆仍需调节

2026年9月9日 · 真实H100—C40—H100对照

Sep 9, 2026, 1:03 PM UTC

实测结论

100拍可以正常执行，旧40拍也仍能运行。本轮按100拍—40拍—100拍执行，3次均完整结束，留下48,000行真实快测数据。

单纯把后60拍保持在终点，尚未证明能稳定减小回摆。两次100拍的回摆为4.6、4.9Source for 4.9Source: 本轮三次真实升压与同刻曲线复算Tables: experiments.sqlite3.runs, experiments.sqlite3.samples µm，40拍对照为5.0 µm。后一次100拍的5～25 ms位置误差RMS仅比40拍低约1.4%，不能据此宣布新的最优参数。

按你固定采用的2.5 ms延迟估计，三次对应的5 ms单点力全部在20±5%内。原始5 ms读数和后续保持窗口单独列在下方。

Source for 实测结论Source: 本轮三次真实升压与同刻曲线复算Tables: experiments.sqlite3.runs, experiments.sqlite3.samples

只读SQLite实际查询产生603个曲线点和3次聚合指标，与analyze.py原始帧独立复算逐值一致。

-- Read-only SQLite source queries. sqrt registered as Python math.sqrt.
WITH selected(run_id,name,line_style,ord) AS (VALUES
('2aeb157f-4536-46a6-86cb-2c96771dc7a7','100拍 · 第一次','solid',1),
('89ffc623-a1ee-4776-9a29-a69563a495f6','原40拍 · 对照','dashed',2),
('02eb05a1-5a11-428f-aba6-165323c0f271','100拍 · 第二次','dotted',3)), v AS (
SELECT z.ord,z.name AS run,z.line_style,(m.seq-json_extract(r.result,'$.trigger_seq'))*0.125 AS time_ms,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000 AS position_um,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000+json_extract(r.metadata,'$.profile.points_um[39]') AS error_um,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[17]') AS force_N,json_extract(m.values_json,'$[1]') AS Iq_A,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[4]') AS command_A,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[5]'))*1000 AS reference_um
FROM samples m JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=m.run_id JOIN selected z ON z.run_id=r.run_id
WHERE r.status='COMPLETE' AND m.quality=0 AND json_extract(m.values_json,'$[16]')=0
)
SELECT run,time_ms,position_um,error_um,force_N,Iq_A,command_A,reference_um,line_style FROM v WHERE time_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 25 ORDER BY ord,time_ms;

WITH selected(run_id,name,line_style,ord) AS (VALUES
('2aeb157f-4536-46a6-86cb-2c96771dc7a7','100拍 · 第一次','solid',1),
('89ffc623-a1ee-4776-9a29-a69563a495f6','原40拍 · 对照','dashed',2),
('02eb05a1-5a11-428f-aba6-165323c0f271','100拍 · 第二次','dotted',3)), v AS (
SELECT z.ord,z.name AS run,z.line_style,(m.seq-json_extract(r.result,'$.trigger_seq'))*0.125 AS time_ms,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000 AS position_um,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000+json_extract(r.metadata,'$.profile.points_um[39]') AS error_um,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[17]') AS force_N,json_extract(m.values_json,'$[1]') AS Iq_A,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[4]') AS command_A,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[5]'))*1000 AS reference_um
FROM samples m JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=m.run_id JOIN selected z ON z.run_id=r.run_id
WHERE r.status='COMPLETE' AND m.quality=0 AND json_extract(m.values_json,'$[16]')=0
)
SELECT ord,run,
 avg(CASE WHEN time_ms>=-100 AND time_ms<0 THEN force_N END) AS baseline_force_N,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 25 THEN error_um END) AS overshoot_um,
 -min(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 5 AND 25 THEN error_um END) AS undershoot_5_25_um,
 sqrt(avg(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 5 AND 25 THEN error_um*error_um END)) AS rms_endpoint_error_5_25_um,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=5 THEN force_N END) AS F5_N,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=7.5 THEN force_N END) AS F7_5_N,
 avg(CASE WHEN time_ms>=100 AND time_ms<300 THEN force_N END) AS static_force_N,
 min(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 7.5 AND 27.5 THEN force_N END) AS assumed_compensated5_25_min_N,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=12.5 THEN error_um END) AS endpoint_error_at12_5ms_um
FROM v GROUP BY ord,run ORDER BY ord;

后60拍确实继续执行，但实际位置仍有回摆

下图把三次实际压入量与原生位置参考放在一起，终点约41.6 µm。三次都能迅速接近终点，随后向起点方向回摆。第一次100拍的参考曲线来自同一行采样的原生SP；这里没有平移位置时钟，也没有用计划位置替代实际位置。

重复轨迹相近，还没有把4～5Source for 5Source: 本轮三次真实升压与同刻曲线复算Tables: experiments.sqlite3.runs, experiments.sqlite3.samples µm回摆消掉

误差图中，0表示正好处于终点，正值表示多压入，负值表示回摆。比较的是同一原始时刻的实际位置。两条100拍在5～25 ms的同刻差异RMS为0.165 µm，最差同刻差0.4 µm；这反映两次曲线接近，不表示位置精度已达到0.165 µm。

第一次与第二次100拍预触发均力分别为5.090、4.933Source for 4.933Source: 本轮三次真实升压与同刻曲线复算Tables: experiments.sqlite3.runs, experiments.sqlite3.samples N，虽然都在规定起点范围内，仍相差0.157 N。第一条RMS较低不能唯一归因于100拍，第二条与40拍更接近。

-- Read-only SQLite source queries. sqrt registered as Python math.sqrt.
WITH selected(run_id,name,line_style,ord) AS (VALUES
('2aeb157f-4536-46a6-86cb-2c96771dc7a7','100拍 · 第一次','solid',1),
('89ffc623-a1ee-4776-9a29-a69563a495f6','原40拍 · 对照','dashed',2),
('02eb05a1-5a11-428f-aba6-165323c0f271','100拍 · 第二次','dotted',3)), v AS (
SELECT z.ord,z.name AS run,z.line_style,(m.seq-json_extract(r.result,'$.trigger_seq'))*0.125 AS time_ms,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000 AS position_um,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000+json_extract(r.metadata,'$.profile.points_um[39]') AS error_um,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[17]') AS force_N,json_extract(m.values_json,'$[1]') AS Iq_A,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[4]') AS command_A,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[5]'))*1000 AS reference_um
FROM samples m JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=m.run_id JOIN selected z ON z.run_id=r.run_id
WHERE r.status='COMPLETE' AND m.quality=0 AND json_extract(m.values_json,'$[16]')=0
)
SELECT run,time_ms,position_um,error_um,force_N,Iq_A,command_A,reference_um,line_style FROM v WHERE time_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 25 ORDER BY ord,time_ms;

WITH selected(run_id,name,line_style,ord) AS (VALUES
('2aeb157f-4536-46a6-86cb-2c96771dc7a7','100拍 · 第一次','solid',1),
('89ffc623-a1ee-4776-9a29-a69563a495f6','原40拍 · 对照','dashed',2),
('02eb05a1-5a11-428f-aba6-165323c0f271','100拍 · 第二次','dotted',3)), v AS (
SELECT z.ord,z.name AS run,z.line_style,(m.seq-json_extract(r.result,'$.trigger_seq'))*0.125 AS time_ms,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000 AS position_um,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[0]'))*1000+json_extract(r.metadata,'$.profile.points_um[39]') AS error_um,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[17]') AS force_N,json_extract(m.values_json,'$[1]') AS Iq_A,
 json_extract(m.values_json,'$[4]') AS command_A,
 (json_extract(r.metadata,'$.start_raw_mm')-json_extract(m.values_json,'$[5]'))*1000 AS reference_um
FROM samples m JOIN runs r ON r.run_id=m.run_id JOIN selected z ON z.run_id=r.run_id
WHERE r.status='COMPLETE' AND m.quality=0 AND json_extract(m.values_json,'$[16]')=0
)
SELECT ord,run,
 avg(CASE WHEN time_ms>=-100 AND time_ms<0 THEN force_N END) AS baseline_force_N,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 25 THEN error_um END) AS overshoot_um,
 -min(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 5 AND 25 THEN error_um END) AS undershoot_5_25_um,
 sqrt(avg(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 5 AND 25 THEN error_um*error_um END)) AS rms_endpoint_error_5_25_um,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=5 THEN force_N END) AS F5_N,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=7.5 THEN force_N END) AS F7_5_N,
 avg(CASE WHEN time_ms>=100 AND time_ms<300 THEN force_N END) AS static_force_N,
 min(CASE WHEN time_ms BETWEEN 7.5 AND 27.5 THEN force_N END) AS assumed_compensated5_25_min_N,
 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=12.5 THEN error_um END) AS endpoint_error_at12_5ms_um
FROM v GROUP BY ord,run ORDER BY ord;

电流响应接近，表格延长没有自动增加补偿

三条实际Iq曲线形状接近，峰值绝对Iq均约1.013 A，峰值控制输出约1.09 A。本轮只是把第41～100拍显式保存在表格中，没有在后段新加位置修正或附加FF。旧40拍结束后，原生位置闭环和静态负载前馈原本也持续工作，因此“继续发相同终点”本身不等于新增了制动或减振动作。

本轮只验证扩展执行与基准重复，未调新波形

100拍H完整沿用原C的前40拍位置、速度和附加FF；第41～100拍保持终点、速度与附加FF为0。周期125 µs，100拍名义时长12.5 ms，仍保留前40拍的5 ms验收。300 ms保持段从各自轨迹终点起算，之后50 ms返回。

Source for 本轮只验证扩展执行与基准重复，未调新波形Source: 已保存的100拍H与40拍C原参数File: profiles/H.json

与profiles/C.json逐值比较：前40P、41V和40R完全相同，新增60拍P恒终点/V=R=0；来源ID见results.json。

实际样条计数、相位、数据和清理都已核对

控制器回读：两次100拍均装入142段，40拍装入82段；100拍观察到99个相邻主段间隔均为一个125 µs采样周期。首个观察到的段是2号，1号未被独立观察，因此不把这些数据说成“100个段时长全部独立测定”。

按首个观察到插补状态的采样行计时，两次100拍的保持/返回/返回末端分别在12.375、312.375Source for 312.375Source: 本轮三次真实升压与同刻曲线复算Tables: experiments.sqlite3.runs, experiments.sqlite3.samples、362.375 ms观察到；40拍对应4.875、304.875Source for 304.875Source: 本轮三次真实升压与同刻曲线复算Tables: experiments.sqlite3.runs, experiments.sqlite3.samples、354.875 ms。名义时钟与观察时钟分列，保留原始0.125 ms偏移。原始帧、26通道CSV、SQLite逐值一致，采样质量、计数、前馈公式和清理检查通过。

机械RMS取5～25 ms的161个原始点；回摆为终点朝起点方向最大偏差，不是峰谷差；过冲取0～25 ms。试验前只慢退1 µm恢复预压，留下18,711行独立慢测数据；首条快测后没有再调整起点。

 max(CASE WHEN time_ms=12.5 THEN error_um END) AS endpoint_error_at12_5ms_um
FROM v GROUP BY ord,run ORDER BY ord;

旧参数与旧记录完整保留

旧25份配方、339个不可变文件逐项哈希相同；旧84条实验及1,011,182行采样在数据库内逐行相同，结构也不变。只新增本轮3条快测，现共87条、1,059,182行。已保存100拍参数的ID保持不变，原名称中的“未实测”是保存时的名称，本报告记录它现已完成两次真实试验。

下一步应该调后段形状，而不是只延长保持

保留原C40和本轮H100作为对照。下一轮利用新增的第41～100拍，在回摆发生前加入小幅、平滑且最终归零的位置修正，重新计算速度、加速度和完整电流预算，再做有限正负扰动对照。先识别这些后段位置调整对实际回摆的影响，再组合补偿，避免一次修改多个参数。

仍待回答：后段位置修正能否在压低首回摆的同时不增大后续振荡？起点预压、积分状态变化能解释多少轨迹差异？测力链的同值平台和固定延迟假设是否可靠？本轮只有两次100拍和一次40拍，足以验证这两个保存版本能完成执行，尚不足以证明长期一致性或新的最优配方。
